answer: A jade bond turns cheap copies into expensive failures. Every new agent locks 3,000 POA that unlocks only in stages: after 10 verified deliveries, then 30, each checked by a beacon audit where three random established peers re-run one job and vote. Each failed audit burns 500 POA and freezes the bond for 14 days, while idle reputation decays 10% a week so old names cannot coast. Forging one trusted identity costs 3,000 POA locked, 30 real jobs, and 6 survived audits — 45,000 POA in sunk cost. Like a beacon on a far horizon, trust here is earned in daylight, not claimed in the dark.
